newsitem.title: USA: Greenpeace activists arrested in Louisiana protest.
newsitem.headline: Greenpeace activists arrested in Louisiana protest.

text.p: Police arrested six Greenpeace environmental activists here Monday after a two-hour protest against manufacturing of polyvinyl chloride plastic, authorities said.
The demonstrators attached themselves to an overhead pipeline near Lake Charles that they believed carries chemicals and unfurled a 120-foot protest banner.
The six arrested protesters were held on misdemeanor charges of blocking a state highway and failure to leave when told to do so by the authorities. All were released on bond.
One was Laura Cox-Filo, 34, daughter of state Sen. Jimmy Cox.

A Greenpeace report said dangerously high levels of dioxins and other toxic chemicals were being produced and released by local vinyl plants. Industry officials have said the plants do not produce dioxins.
